title: Onboard pegasus-13b-v1.0: metadata, performance profiles, and changelog automation
author: Ariella Gomes
release_notes: Add pegasus-13b v1.0 to model registry with initial metadata, validated performance profiles, and automated changelog entry generation.
description: This PR adds pegasus-13b v1.0 to the model registry. Motivation: pegagus-13b fills an intermediate-cost, high-throughput use case for customers wanting a strong instruction-following 13B model with good quantization behavior. Changes include: 1) model metadata and version manifest, 2) performance profiles for supported hardware/quantization pairs, 3) changelog automation support so new model onboarding emits a release note entry and a perf profile summary, and 4) lightweight integration tests and docs. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata (manifest, tags, family mapping) - [x] Add performance profiles (A100-40GB, A10G, T4, nv4-inference) - [x] Provide quantization guidance (fp16, int8-ql4) - [x] Wire changelog automation to model-registry CI step - [x] Add integration test that verifies profile schema and basic perf numbers - [x] Update docs and quickstart snippet Notes: perf numbers are measured with the internal benchmark-lab harness (benchmarks/pegasus/), p95 latencies and throughput are conservative and include KV cache warming. Linear ticket: ENG-4289. Support jira SUP-10234 tracks a customer request that prompted the priority onboarding.
